en.headline: PLA Hong Kong Garrison marks 99th anniversary of army founding with reception
en.dek: Political commissar Rear Admiral Lai Ruxin and Chief Executive John Lee spoke at the event held at Ngong Shuen Chau Barracks on Stonecutters Island.
body: The People’s Liberation Army Hong Kong Garrison held a reception on Saturday to mark the 99th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army.

The event took place at Ngong Shuen Chau Barracks on Stonecutters Island. Garrison political commissar Rear Admiral Lai Ruxin said the troops would continue to bolster defence capacity to safeguard Hong Kong’s stability and prosperity, promote patriotic and national defence education, and carry out duties in accordance with the law while remaining loyal to the Communist Party of China and supporting the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government’s governance under the principle of ‘one country, two systems’ and the Basic Law.

Chief Executive John Lee attended and offered congratulations. He saluted the garrison for its role in safeguarding national sovereignty, security and development interests, and for supporting Hong Kong’s safety, social stability and lawful governance since the return to the motherland.

zh.headline: 駐港部隊舉行建軍99周年招待會
zh.dek: 政治委員賴汝新少將及行政長官李家超在昂船洲軍營出席活動並致辭。
body: 中國人民解放軍駐香港部隊星期六舉行招待會，慶祝中國人民解放軍建軍99周年。
活動在昂船洲軍營舉行。駐軍政治委員賴汝新少將表示，部隊將繼續加強防衛能力，維護香港穩定繁榮，推動愛國主義及國防教育，依法履行職責，忠於中國共產黨，並按照「一國兩制」及《基本法》支持特區政府依法施政。
行政長官李家超出席並致賀詞。他向駐軍致敬，感謝部隊自回歸以來在維護國家主權、安全及發展利益，以及支持香港安全、社會穩定和依法管治方面的貢獻。
